terms.label: All whitespace-delimited tokens in the KJV concordance text

label: First & Last Words of First & Last Verses = 77,777
note: In (Gen 1:1 first) + earth (Gen 1:1 last) + The (Rev 22:21 first) + Amen (Rev 22:21 last)

terms.label: "earth" — last word of Genesis 1:1 (exact lowercase only)
"Amen" — last word of Revelation 22:21 (exact capital-A only)

label: God('s) + Moses(') + Jesus = 77×77 = 5,929
note: God('s)=4,101 + Moses(')=848 + Jesus pure=980. Verse-level exclusion of 3 antimetion verses (Acts 7:45, Col 4:11, Heb 4:8) which also contain God. kjvcode.com reports 4102+847 for the individual names; we get 4101+848 — same total 5,929.

label: Moses(') + Aaron(*) = 1,200 (entire Bible)
note: Moses(')=848 (base+possessives), Aaron(*)=352 (base+Aaron's+Aaronites in 1 Chr 12:27 & 27:17). 1,200 reflects 12 tribes they led. No antimentions.

label: Five Fishermen (John 21:2) = 153× in the Gospels
note: Peter(97)+Thomas(11)+Nathanael(6)+James(19)+John(20)=153. James excludes James the Less (8×) and half-brother of Jesus (2×). John uses a whitelist of 20 apostle-John verses; all other Gospel 'John' mentions = John the Baptist (83 excluded).

label: Jesus + Elijah + Elias = 77×7 + 77×7 = 1,078
note: Jesus pure=980, Elijah=68 (Ezra 10:21 excluded — different person), Elias=30. Total 1,078 = 2×539 = 2×(77×7). No possessives of Elijah or Elias exist in the KJV.

elijah_antimentions.note: A different Elijah — one of the sons of Harim who took a foreign wife

label: Jesus + Christ('s) + David('s) + Abraham('s) = 980×3 = 2,940
note: Jesus pure=980, Christ('s)=571, David('s)=1139, Abraham('s)=250. Possessives use curly apostrophes in the text. Same 3 Jesus antimentions as pattern 3.

label: Jesus + GOD (uppercase titles) = 7,777
note: All-caps names of God (LORD, GOD, JEHOVAH, I AM, JAH) + all-caps Christ titles (BRANCH, KING) + Jesus/JESUS pure (980). I AM counts only Exodus 3:14's 3 occurrences — where God defines his own name.

label: Total Verses = 7,774 + 7,775 + 7,776 + 7,777 = 31,102
note: 31,102 is the unique four-consecutive-integer staircase ending on 7,777

label: Jesus(*) + Christ(*) = 777 + 777 = 1,554
note: Jesus(*) = Jesus + Jesus' + JESUS (all caps). Christ(*) = Christ + Christs + Christ's + Christian + Christians. 3 Jesus antimentions + 2 false-Christ antimentions excluded.

label: Father + Son = 70×7 = 490 (entire Bible)
note: Capital-F Father (259 = 37×7) + capital-S Son (231 = 33×7). Possessives and antimentions excluded.

label: Jesus = 70×7 in Every Other NT Book (980 total)
note: 490 in odd-numbered NT books + 490 in even-numbered NT books. 4 antimentions excluded (Acts 7:45, Acts 13:6, Colossians 4:11, Hebrews 4:8).
